stories.title: Man's body pulled from Buffalo Bayou, Houston police say
stories.summary: We don't yet know the man's cause of death or his identity.

stories.title: Man shot and killed after argument at apartment complex near Memorial Park, Houston police say
stories.summary: A man was shot and killed after an argument at a Houston apartment complex near Memorial Park. Police say the suspected shooter was detained.

stories.title: Federal agencies issue aviation security warning ahead of busy Thanksgiving travel week
stories.summary: Federal officials are urging airlines to remain vigilant following al Qaeda messaging about aviation attacks ahead of the holiday travel rush.

stories.title: Family seeks answers after single mother of two struck and killed while walking puppy in NW Houston
stories.summary: Grecia Gonzalez was killed while walking her dog in northwest Houston. Her family is now calling for safety improvements as investigators seek answers.

stories.title: Father who helped family escape burning Houston Heights townhome dies from injuries
stories.summary: A father who suffered severe burns while helping his family escape a burning Heights townhome has died, according to the Buzbee Law Firm.

stories.title: Texas lawmaker proposes 'Lorenzo Salgado Araujo Day' to honor Houston father killed by federal immigration officers
stories.summary: Texas Rep. Christina Morales filed a bill to designate July 7 as a day of remembrance for a Houston father killed by federal immigration officers.

stories.title: Could Houston's rainbow crosswalks return? Mayor Whitmire signals support after renewed community push
stories.summary: Houston leaders are working to restore Montrose's iconic rainbow crosswalks more than a year after their removal, with hopes they could return as early as January.

stories.title: Family fights parole approval for woman convicted in deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash
stories.summary: A Houston family is fighting the parole approval of a woman convicted in a deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash after she served about three years.

stories.title: ‘It’s weird to me’ | Louisiana targets Houstonians with billboards urging former residents to move back
stories.summary: Louisiana Economic Development officials said the campaign was sparked, in part, by the results of the election and anticipated policy changes in Texas.

stories.title: Houston's East End has waited decades for train crossing relief. Could a $175M underpass finally solve it?
stories.summary: Harris County secured $10.5 million in federal funding to design an underpass at a frequently blocked railroad crossing in Houston's East End.

stories.title: New strategy by newly elected Harris County Attorney aims to permanently shutter allegedly illegal game rooms
stories.summary: Harris County Attorney Abbie Kamin said game rooms are among the top issues recently brought up in town hall meetings.

stories.title: HPD: Shooting at southwest Houston home leads to SWAT response, one detained
stories.summary: One person was shot in the leg at a southwest Houston home Friday afternoon. SWAT officers cleared the residence and detained another person, police said.
